acceptance_gate_results.principle: Missing or invalid prerequisites cannot become a scientific null.
One valid panel cannot conceal an unqualified second panel.
Nested, missing, or incompatible timing cannot inflate support.
Favorable evidence cannot excuse failed affected-code checks.
Self-reported reduction cannot replace cold replay and strict readers.
A valid null must not lower unrelated accounting completion.
Different sources require separate descriptive panels.
Fewer than 30 episodes cannot support the pooled cost claim.
Repeated seeds cannot replace at least 10 unique games.
Different interval protocols cannot share a denominator.
Unknown stage time must suppress cost shares and Amdahl bounds.
A shadow firing with unknown eligibility cannot establish efficacy.
An all-zero progress panel cannot establish broad transfer.
